name: FA_BONUS_RULES
description: FA_BONUS_RULES contains information about your bonus depreciation rules. Oracle inserts a row into this table for each bonus rule that you define.

columns.name: BONUS_RULE_ID
columns.description: Identifier of the depreciation bonus rule.

columns.name: BONUS_RULE
columns.description: Name of the bonus depreciation rule.

columns.name: DESCRIPTION
columns.description: Description of the bonus depreciation rule.

columns.name: ONE_TIME_FLAG
columns.description: Option indicating whether the bonus rule is for one time use or not.

columns.name: SET_ID
columns.description: Identifies a set of reference data shared across business units and other entities. Also known as Reference Data Sets, they are used to filter reference data in transactional UIs.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.

columns.name: CALCULATION_BASIS_CODE
columns.description: The base amount on which the bonus rate is to be applied to calculate the bonus depreciation amount.

columns.name: RATE_TYPE_CODE
columns.description: Specifies the type of the bonus depreciation rate.

columns.name: CALENDAR_TYPE
columns.description: The name of the calendar the bonus rate are entered.

columns.name: UNPLANNED_RULE_FLAG
columns.description: An option to directly assign a bonus rule to an asset. It will be only used to create unplanned depreciation amount.

columns.name: TRACKING_TYPE_CODE
columns.description: Track and account bonus amount separately or include in the periodic depreciation.

columns.name: BONUS_CLASS_CODE
columns.description: User-defined bonus depreciation classification.

columns.name: COUNTRY
columns.description: The name of the country that requires this bonus depreciation rule.

columns.name: ROUNDING_RULE_CODE
columns.description: Rule used to round the calculated bonus depreciation amount.

columns.name: DEPRN_SUBJECT_CODE
columns.description: Japan legal article number for the special and additional depreciation.

columns.name: RECAPTURE_YEAR
columns.description: Minimum number of years an asset has to be used in business to avoid bonus depreciation reversal.
